'''Siamak Yassemi''' (Persian: سیامک یاسمی; born 1959) is an Iranian mathematician specializing in [[commutative algebra]], [[homological algebra]], and [[combinatorics]]. He is an Associate Professor of Practice in Mathematics at [[Purdue University]] in Indianapolis. He previously served as Dean of the Faculty of Mathematics, Statistics and Computer Science at the [[University of Tehran]].<ref name="Purdue">{{Cite web
|url=https://www.math.purdue.edu/people/profile/syassemi.html
|title=Siamak Yassemi
|publisher=Purdue University Department of Mathematics
|access-date=2026-09-04
}}</ref><ref name="PurdueNews">{{Cite web
|url=https://www.math.purdue.edu/news/2025/department-of-mathematics-welcomes-new-faculty-for-2025-26-academic-year.html
|title=Department of Mathematics Welcomes New Faculty for 2025-26 Academic Year
|publisher=Purdue University Department of Mathematics
|access-date=2026-09-04
}}</ref>

Yassemi's research is in commutative algebra and homological algebra, with connections to combinatorics. His work includes research on monomial ideals, edge ideals of graphs, Cohen–Macaulay properties, and homological dimensions.<ref name="TWAS">{{Cite web
|url=https://www.twas.org/directory/yassemi-siamak
|title=Yassemi, Siamak
|publisher=The World Academy of Sciences
|access-date=2026-09-04
}}</ref><ref name="TWASpubs">{{Cite web
|url=https://twas.org/sites/default/files/affiliates-publications/publication-list-24-december-2021.pdf
|title=Full List of Publications of Siamak Yassemi
|publisher=The World Academy of Sciences
|access-date=2026-09-04
}}</ref>

Yassemi is a Fellow of [[The World Academy of Sciences]] (TWAS), having been elected in 2018 in the field of Mathematical Sciences.<ref name="TWAS2018">{{Cite web
|url=https://twas.org/article/twas-elects-55-new-fellows
|title=TWAS elects 55 new Fellows
|publisher=The World Academy of Sciences
|date=2018
|access-date=2026-09-04
}}</ref> According to a profile published by [[COMSTECH]], he became a member of TWAS in 2018 as the first Iranian mathematician to do so.<ref name="COMSTECH">{{Cite web
|url=https://www.comstech.org/wp-content/uploads/2021/07/Prof.-Dr.-Siamak-Yassemi-profile.pdf
|title=Prof. Dr. Siamak Yassemi
|publisher=COMSTECH
|access-date=2026-09-04
}}</ref> The distinction was also reported by the [[Mehr News Agency]] in 2019.<ref name="Mehr">{{Cite web
|url=https://en.mehrnews.com/amp/150579/
|title=Iranian mathematician receives Order of Academic Palms
|publisher=Mehr News Agency
|date=2019-09-28
|access-date=2026-09-04
}}</ref>

== Early life and education ==

Yassemi was born in 1959 in [[Khorramshahr]], Iran.<ref name="TWAS" /> He completed his PhD in mathematics at the [[University of Copenhagen]] in 1994 under the supervision of [[Hans-Bjørn Foxby]].<ref name="TWAS" />

His undergraduate and master's education was completed in Iran. He received a B.Sc. in mathematics from [[Shahid Beheshti University]] in Tehran in 1985 and an M.Sc. in mathematics, specializing in geometry and topology, from the [[Shahid Bahonar University of Kerman|University of Kerman]] in 1988. He graduated from [[Alborz High School]] in Tehran in 1977.<ref>{{Cite web
|url=https://profile.ut.ac.ir/en/~yassemi
|title=Siamak Yassemi
|publisher=University of Tehran
|access-date=2026-09-04
}}</ref>

== Academic career ==

Yassemi has held academic and administrative positions at the [[University of Tehran]] and the [[Institute for Research in Fundamental Sciences]] (IPM). He served as Head of the School of Mathematics at IPM from 2007 to 2009 and later served as Head of the School of Mathematics, Statistics and Computer Science at the University of Tehran from 2014 to 2020.<ref name="TWAS" /><ref name="COMSTECH" />

He served as Dean of the Faculty of Mathematics, Statistics and Computer Science at the University of Tehran from 2013 to 2021.<ref name="UTDean">{{Cite web
|url=http://science.ut.ac.ir/web/math
|title=Faculty of Mathematics, Statistics and Computer Science
|publisher=University of Tehran
|access-date=2026-09-04
}}</ref>

In 2025, Yassemi joined [[Purdue University]] in Indianapolis as an Associate Professor of Practice in Mathematics.<ref name="PurdueNews" />

== Research ==

Yassemi works in commutative algebra and homological algebra, particularly on interactions between algebraic and combinatorial structures. His research has included monomial ideals and edge ideals of graphs, Cohen–Macaulay properties, homological dimensions, and related topics.<ref name="TWAS" /><ref name="TWASpubs" />

His publication record includes more than 165 research papers, covering topics in commutative algebra, homological algebra, and combinatorics.<ref name="COMSTECH" />

== Honors and memberships ==

* In 2009, Yassemi received the [[Khwarizmi International Award]] in Basic Sciences and the [[COMSTECH]] International Award for work on homological and combinatorial methods in commutative algebra.<ref name="TWAS" /><ref name="COMSTECH" />
* He was an associate member of the [[International Centre for Theoretical Physics]] (ICTP) from 1996 to 2004.<ref name="TWAS" />
* In 2018, he was elected a Fellow of [[The World Academy of Sciences]] (TWAS) in Mathematical Sciences.<ref name="TWAS2018" /> According to COMSTECH, he was the first Iranian mathematician elected to TWAS.<ref name="COMSTECH" /><ref name="Mehr" />
* In 2019, he was named a Chevalier of the [[Ordre des Palmes Académiques]] by France for distinguished efforts in international academic and scientific cooperation, including research projects, student and faculty exchanges, and the organization of schools and conferences.<ref name="Mehr" />

Yassemi has also visited the [[Max Planck Institute for Mathematics]] in Bonn, the [[Institut des hautes études scientifiques]] in France, and the [[Tata Institute of Fundamental Research]] in Mumbai.<ref name="TWAS" />

In the 2024–2025 academic year, Yassemi was a Shelly Visiting Professor in the Department of Mathematical Sciences at [[Carnegie Mellon University]] in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania.<ref>{{Cite web
|url=https://aco.math.cmu.edu/seminar20242025.html
|title=The ACO Seminar, 2024–2025
|publisher=Carnegie Mellon University
|access-date=2026-09-04
}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web
|url=https://csd.cmu.edu/calendar/aco-seminar-siamak-yassemi
|title=ACO Seminar - Siamak Yassemi
|publisher=Carnegie Mellon University
|date=2025-02-20
|access-date=2026-09-04
}}</ref>

In April 2022, Yassemi was a Research Member at the [[Simons Laufer Mathematical Sciences Institute]] (then the Mathematical Sciences Research Institute, MSRI) in Berkeley, California, where he collaborated primarily with MSRI Director [[David Eisenbud]].<ref>{{Cite web
|url=https://legacy.slmath.org/system/cms/files/1252/files/original/2021-22_NSF_Annual_Report_New_Core_Web_Version.pdf
|title=2021–2022 Annual Report
|publisher=Mathematical Sciences Research Institute
|access-date=2026-09-04
}}</ref>
